name: waves
description: Product Consciousness Framework for AI agents. Complete product lifecycle: feasibility analysis with Monte Carlo/Bayesian projections, product foundation, blueprint, roadmaps, logbooks, resolutions. Supports software, general, and agentic project types. Includes governing_principles (organizational governance anchor), 4 defense layers (inline rules + banner + post-impl audit + integrity audit), adversarial subagents (orthogonality reviewer + verifier pattern), background metacognition, and multi-session continuity. Replaces Scrum/Kanban with organic delivery cycles called waves.
